title: Export structured AI eval run data
summary: AI Eval run data can now be exported in a structured form from the AI Test Toolkit command-line page, with optional authorized Agent Task details. Agent Task gains public GetTaskLogEntryDetails overloads, and the old record-based GetLogEntryDetails public method is removed.
key_points: The AI Eval command-line page streams results.json, the evaluation result files and then the Agent Task detail files, keeping the suite/version/dataset hierarchy
New public Agent Task methods: GetTaskLogEntryDetails(AgentTaskID) returns the full task export and GetTaskLogEntryDetails(AgentTaskID, StepNumber) returns a single log entry
The AI Test Toolkit now uses the public API, and its internalsVisibleTo grants and the unused stream/BLOB adapter are removed
The old record-based GetLogEntryDetails public method is removed
Multiline messages and call stacks are now read to the end of the stream, with separators only between lines
quote: Export structured AI Eval run data for analysis and automation, with optional authorized Agent Task troubleshooting details.
